sloka: वक्त्रं प्रसारयामास पाताLआन्तरसन्निभम् ।घनराजीव गर्जन्ती वानरं सम्भिद्रवत् ॥५-१-१९०॥
transliteration: vaktraṁ prasārayāmāsa pātāLāntarasannibham ।ghanarājīva garjantī vānaraṁ sambhidravat ॥5-1-190॥

translations.english: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.
